messages:
nora: Customer onboarding hiccup — they accepted invite, added card, quickstart shows Ready, but first API call returns 402 then later succeeds. They think Ready means fully provisioned.

diego: Which sample and SDK?

nora: Go sample app, SDK v0.9.0 pinned. Curl they ran: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_ZZZ" -d '{"model":"redwood/small","input":"hey"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 402 {"error":"billing_required"}

qa-bot: Infra metrics: billing webhook median 9s, 95th 38s in us-east-1 last 6h.

diego: Old SDK treats 402 as retriable; it does 3 quick retries which confuses users and may cause extra logs. We should not retry on 4xx except 429.

nora: User eventually retried and got 200 after ~30s. They're worried about being billed for failed attempts and the UI being misleading.

infra: Quick mitigation: update sample app to display "Payment processing — finalizing workspace" until backend confirms workspace.active=true.

diego: I'll patch SDK default retry policy in v0.9.2 and add a config flag allowClientErrorRetries. Add unit tests too.

nora: I'll DM the customer, explain the delay and confirm no duplicate charges. Filing internal note in onboarding board.

qa-bot: created ticket DX-452 for docs blurb: "Billing may take up to 1 minute".

diego: Sounds good — PRs incoming.

nora: Thanks everyone.
